title: Refresh Tina lockfile for the articles collection CI schema check
description: Follow-up to GitHub issue #34 / PR #35: tina/config.ts added the articles collection but tina/tina-lock.json was never regenerated (only tinacms dev writes that tracked file). CI runs tinacms build with TinaCloud env, so the local schema (home+articles) no longer matches the remote schema (home) and the Placeholder contract job fails at the deterministic quality gate. Regenerate the lock with tinacms dev --no-server --noWatch so TinaCloud can index the new schema, and keep the change limited to the tracked lockfile.
closeReason: Regenerated tracked tina/tina-lock.json with 'tinacms dev --no-server --noWatch'; lock now contains the articles and home collections. bun run quality is green; only the tracked lock changed.
